g11.sentence: Artists often seek a coalition of support from local communities for their projects.
g11.translation_zh: 艺术家们通常希望从当地社区获得对其项目的支持联盟。

g11.sentence: Activists will contend against proposed legislation limiting civil rights.
g11.translation_zh: 活动人士将主张反对限制公民权利的提案。

g11.sentence: Management's actions may diminish the value of our hard work.
g11.translation_zh: 管理层的行为可能会贬低我们辛苦工作的价值。
g11.problem: 翻译中缺少了“可能”这个词
